description: The chart illustrates the performance comparison of various models on two tasks, MATH-500 and AIME24, with six sub-charts displaying the results. The horizontal axis contains categories representing different models, while the vertical axis represents the performance score, labeled with a range from 0 to 100 for MATH-500 and 0 to 90 for AIME24, with a linear scale and tick label intervals of 5 or 10. In each sub-chart, bars are grouped by model, with different colors and patterns indicating distinct models and techniques, such as CoT and TTS, as shown in the legend. The bars are labeled with their corresponding model names and sizes, and their heights represent the performance scores, ranging from approximately 9.3 to 97.3. The models are not sorted in a specific order, and some bars are annotated with their exact scores. The sub-charts (a) and (d) compare the performance of Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, GPT-4o, and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct on MATH-500 and AIME24, respectively, with scores ranging from 71.4 to 78.2 and 9.3 to 30.0. Sub-charts (b) and (e) show the performance of GPT-4o, o1-mini, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B on MATH-500 and AIME24, with scores between 85.5 and 91.6 and 44.6 and 63.6. Sub-charts (c) and (f) display the results for DeepSeek-R1, o1-preview, and o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, with scores ranging from 94.8 to 97.3 and 79.2 to 83.3. Overall, the chart provides a detailed comparison of the performance of various models on the two tasks.
